dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly irregular posterior margin characterized by deep, jagged indentations and non-continuous splines, resulting in a fractured falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrow, rounded apex with a small pixel radius, showing significant micro-irregularities due to apparent tissue erosion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 degrees steepness relative to the posterior-anterior body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum visible base width to vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive traumatic notches and tissue loss along the entire trailing edge; numerous white punctate lesions and superficial depigmented scratches visible on the lateral skin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct deep V-shaped notch located approximately one-third down from the apex on the posterior edge.
